content.title: Fanatics Flag Football Classic highlights, results: Team USA dominates exhibition
content.text: 8:35 pm ET March 21, 2026Fanatics Flag Football Classic scores, resultsJacob CamenkerGame 1: Team USA 39, Wildcats FFC 14Game 2: Team USA 43, Founders FFC 16Game 3: Wildcats FFC 34, Founders FFC 26Championship game: Team USA 24, Wildcats FFC 148:34 pm ET March 21, 2026Fanatics Flag Football Classic standingsJacob CamenkerBelow is a look at the standings for the first-ever Fanatics Flag Football Classic:Team USA (3-0)Wildcats FFC (1-2)Founders FFC (0-2)Team USA defeated Wildcats FFC 24-14 in the event's championship game.8:27 pm ET March 21, 2026Team USA wins inaugural Fanatics Flag Football ClassicJacob CamenkerWildcats FFC put up a fight in the championship game, but Team USA's offense was too much for Joe Burrow's squad to overcome. Team USA earned a 24-14 victory to take home the inaugural Fanatics Flag Football Classic title.Team USA was carried by its juggernaut offense, which generated points on 14 of its 15 possessions and proved to be no match for either of the defensive units it played against.Housh Doucette won the MVP award for the tournament after frequently showing off his unique combination of speed and elusiveness. His performance laid credence to his claim he is the best quarterback to lead Team USA into the 2028 Olympics.8:21 pm ET March 21, 2026Velton Brown Jr. catches TD to put Team USA up 10 at 1-minute warningJacob CamenkerWildcats FFC is running out of time to mount a comeback. They had Team USA down to a third-and-goal opportunity, but Brown was able to get wide open in the end-zone and caught an easy pass to give the national team a two-possession lead.Housh Doucette wasn't able to run the 2-point conversion into the end-zone, but the Wildcats are going to have to move quickly to try to erase their 24-14 deficit over the game's final 60 seconds.8:15 pm ET March 21, 2026Wildcats FFC answers Team USA with short score after long Joe Burrow catchJacob CamenkerThe Wildcats are starting to let their creativity shine through a bit more. Saquon Barkley took a pitch and quickly threw it forward to Burrow, who got into a space and made a man miss before being brought down at the 1-yard line.Burrow was then able to throw a 1-yard touchdown before Kyle Juszczyk caught the 2-point conversion to cut Team USA's lead to 18-14.8:11 pm ET March 21, 2026Housh Doucette runs for touchdown to give Team USA two-score leadJacob CamenkerTeam USA took the opening drive of the second half, ran four minutes off the clock and worked its way into the end-zone at the end of Doucette run. The national team couldn't convert the 2-point attempt but has a 12-point lead with time winding down in the championship game.8:00 pm ET March 21, 2026Team USA leads Wildcats FFC 12-6 at halftime of championship gameJacob CamenkerThe Wildcats are playing much better than they did in their first game against Team USA. Joe Burrow is showing a better command over the principles of the game, and seems to be drawing up his own plays in an effort to give his offense a boost.Even so, the national team was able to reach the end-zone on each of its first-half possessions, so Kyle Shanahan's squad will need to come up with a stop at some point in the second half to pull off the upset.7:46 pm ET March 21, 2026Team USA answers with Housh Doucette TD passJacob CamenkerTeam USA didn't waste much time answering Davante Adams' touchdown. Doucette faked that he was going to run the ball and drew Logan Paul up in coverage, which left Ja'Deion High wide open in the middle of the end-zone.The Wildcats were able to hold up better in coverage on the 2-point conversion, preventing Nico Caseras from being able to complete the pass despite several laterals between himself and Doucette.7:43 pm ET March 21, 2026Jayden Daniels hits Davante Adams for deep-ball TD to open scoringJacob CamenkerTeam USA had Wildcats FFC facing a fourth-and-midfield from deep in their own territory on the first possession of the game. Joe Burrow lateraled the ball to Daniels, who eventually found Adams breaking wide open down the field.Daniels feathered a perfect pass to Adams to give the Wildcats an early 6-0 lead.7:33 pm ET March 21, 2026Team USA facing Wildcats FFC in championship gameJacob CamenkerThe Fanatics Flag Football Classic championship game is about to begin. Team USA will look to ride Housh Doucette to a third victory in as many games while Joe Burrow and Jayden Daniels will hope to lead Wildcats FFC to an upset victory.Team USA beat the Wildcats 39-14 in their first meeting of the day.7:18 pm ET March 21, 2026Wildcats advance to championship game with 34-26 win over FoundersJacob CamenkerWildcats FFC will get a second chance to take a shot at Team USA. Kyle Shanahan's squad found a much better rhythm on offense against Sean Payton's team, notching 34 points as Joe Burrow found consistent success through the air while Jayden Daniels showed off some elusive hip movements that could help the Wildcats in their upcoming championship matchup.The Founders tried to overcome a 16-point deficit late, but they simply ran out of time. As a result, Tom Brady will not get a chance to add a Fanatics Flag Football Classic championship to his name.7:09 pm ET March 21, 2026Luke Kuechly interception, Saquon Barkley TD give Wildcats two-score leadJacob CamenkerThe Wildcats and Founders traded scores to start the second half, but Kyle Shanahan's squad got an advantage midway through the second half.The Wildcats were already leading 26-18 when Logan Paul forced Jalen Hurts to throw a ball into the air from the end-zone. Luke Kuechly was able to out-jump a crowd of players and log the interception, positioning the Wildcats to build upon their lead.One play later, Saquon Barkley was able to cut his way through the Founders' defense. He got into the end-zone, and after a successful two-point conversion, the team extended its lead to 34-18.6:55 pm ET March 21, 2026Wildcats leading Founders 20-12 at halftimeJacob CamenkerKyle Shanahan's squad seems to have found a rhythm against Sean Payton's team. Joe Burrow and Jayden Daniels have shown great chemistry in the Wildcats' backfield, while Odell Beckham Jr. has caught two touchdowns for the team in what is turning out to be a showcase day for the veteran.The Founders have punched back, with Jalen Hurts and DeVonta Smith connecting for a couple of scores, but their defense continues to have issues consistently getting stops.The second half will decide which of these teams will get a second chance to try to upset Team USA, which won its two round robin contests by a combined score of 82-30.6:49 pm ET March 21, 2026DeVonta Smith catches twice-deflected ball, scores TDJacob CamenkerSmith connected with Jalen Hurts for their second touchdown of the day, but it came in an improbable manner.Hurts had to launch the ball from roughly 40 yards away on a fourth-and-goal attempt, and he tried to get it to Stefon Diggs. The veteran receiver wasn't able to reel it in, but two players deflected the ball. It popped into the air and landed in the arms of Smith, who was standing in the back of the end-zone.The Founders couldn't convert the 2-point attempt, so they trail 14-12 with time winding down in the first half.6:42 pm ET March 21, 2026Tom Brady throws ball at Logan Paul after play endsJacob CamenkerBrady and Paul were beefing ahead of the Fanatics Flag Football Classic. That rivalry spilled over onto the field, as Brady threw the ball into Paul's chest from close range after the 48-year-old quarterback caught a pass during the Founders vs. Wildcats game.Paul immediately came after Brady, and started jawing with the 48-year-old quarterback. The officials flagged each for unsportsmanlike conduct, much to the chagrin of Paul, who was caught on a hot mic saying it was "crazy" he was penalized after Brady started the incident between the two.6:36 pm ET March 21, 2026Jalen Hurts hits DeVonta Smith for deep-ball touchdownJacob CamenkerSean Payton instructed Smith to attempt a double move on Speed, a YouTuber who is playing cornerback for Wildcats FFC. It worked, and Hurts was able to loft the ball perfectly to his Philadelphia Eagles teammate to get the score.The Founders weren't able to convert their 2-point attempt, so that tied the game up at 6-all.6:33 pm ET March 21, 2026Odell Beckham Jr. high-points fourth-and-goal pass for TDJacob CamenkerBeckham was hoping to turn a good performance at the Fanatics Flag Football Classic into an opportunity with an NFL team. He has looked good across his action so far, and caught his second touchdown of the day in Wildcats FFC's matchup against Founders FFC.Beckham's second score saw him high-point a pass from Joe Burrow and get his feet down with ease after getting up in the air. That gave the Wildcats an early 6-0 lead.6:24 pm ET March 21, 2026Founders FFC vs. Wildcats FFC game beginningJacob CamenkerThe third and final leg of the round robin tournament at the Fanatics Flag Football Classic is set to begin. Tom Brady and Jalen Hurts' Founders will take on Joe Burrow and Jayden Daniels' Wildcats with a trip to the event's championship game on the line.Both teams scored two touchdowns against Team USA, so they figure to be on an even playing field.6:14 pm ET March 21, 2026Fanatics Flag Football Classic scores, resultsJacob CamenkerGame 1: Team USA 39, Wildcats FFC 14Game 2: Team USA 43, Founders FFC 16Game 3: Founders FFC vs. Wildcats FFC6:12 pm ET March 21, 2026Fanatics Flag Football Classic standingsJacob CamenkerBelow is a look at the standings for the Fanatics Football Classic through two games:Team USA (2-0)Founders FFC (0-1)Wildcats FFC (0-1)Team USA has clinched a spot in the event's championship game. They will play the winner of the final round robin game between Founders FFC and Wildcats FFC.6:09 pm ET March 21, 2026Team USA thrashes Tom Brady, Founders FFC to clinch spot in championship gameJacob CamenkerTeam USA has looked unbeatable through the first two games of the Fanatics Flag Football Classic. They allowed Brady to score a touchdown on his team's first possession, but rattled off 43 consecutive points after that to earn an easy 43-16 victory.Team USA has thus far scored on all but one of its possessions during Saturday's game. The lone exception was their final possession of the win over Founders FFC, during which they ran out the remainder of the clock.Team USA will now move onto the round robin tournament's championship game while the Founders and Wildcats clubs will face off for the right to get a second shot at the national team.6:04 pm ET March 21, 2026Tom Brady throws second TD, this time to Jalen HurtsJacob CamenkerThe bad news for Founders FFC: Team USA rattled off 43 consecutive points and looks destined to win a spot in the championship game.The good news? Brady continues to perform well, and Hurts is starting to get into something of a rhythm. Brady gave Hurts a dump-off out of the backfield and the Eagles quarterback managed to elude the defense to get the score.Hurts then threw a 2-point conversion to finish the possession and cut Team USA's lead to 43-16 in the game's waning minutes.5:54 pm ET March 21, 2026Team USA scores on back-to-back plays to open second halfJacob CamenkerAny hope of Founders FFC coming back is quickly slipping away. After Nico Caseres threw a deep touchdown on Team USA's opening drive of the game, Aamir intercepted Jalen Hurts on the very next play and brought it back for a touchdown.Team USA now has a 36-8 lead and if it can protect it, Darrell Doucette's squad will head to the championship game of the inaugural Fanatics Flag Football Classic.5:45 pm ET March 21, 2026Team USA leading Founders 24-8 at halftimeJacob CamenkerTom Brady and Founders FFC scored on their opening possession against Team USA, but their defense was unable to stop the national team defensively.Team USA scored on all three of its first-half possessions and orchestrated a 45-yard scoring drive in the final 12 seconds of the half. It was capped off by a Darrell "Housh" Doucette touchdown pass to Pablo Smith after Doucette received a lateral from his teammate before quickly tossing it downfield.Team USA will get the ball first after halftime, so it may be hard for Brady's squad to come back from the 16-point deficit.5:29 pm ET March 21, 2026Rob Gronkowski injured on 2-point attemptJacob CamenkerGronkowski caught a 2-point conversion on Founders' opening drive, but he was hurt while doing so. The veteran tight end managed to get his feet in for the conversion, but he slipped while getting up on the turf.Gronkowski acknowledged he hurt his hamstring on the play. He said he was doing OK, but he wouldn't be able to return to the game.5:26 pm ET March 21, 2026Tom Brady throws fourth-down TD after avoiding sackJacob CamenkerTom Brady may be 48 years old, but he can still ball. The veteran quarterback checked into the game for the first time on a fourth-and-goal and faded back to throw a pass.Team USA quickly got pressure on Brady, but he managed to deke the defender, step up into space and deliver a perfect strike to Stefon Diggs for the score.Brady then hit Rob Gronkowski on the 2-point attempt to give Founders FFC an early 8-0 lead.5:19 pm ET March 21, 2026Tom Brady, Founders FFC to face Team USA in Game 2Jacob CamenkerBrady is set to take the field with Founders FFC in the second game of the Flag Football Classic. His opponent? Team USA, which just earned a 39-14 win over Joe Burrow and Jayden Daniels' Wildcats.Brady's squad will get the ball first, with Jalen Hurts set to being the game at quarterback.5:09 pm ET March 21, 2026Team USA throttles Wildcats FFC to open tournamentJacob CamenkerTeam USA showed off its supremacy in the flag football space to open the inaugural Fanatics Flag Football Classic. Darrell Doucette's squad earned a 39-14 victory over Joe Burrow and Jayden Daniels' Wildcats in a game Team USA never trailed.The Wildcats had trouble adjusting to the rules of flag football, being penalized several times for illegally contacting Team USA players and struggling to contain the speed of its players in the 5-on-5 format. The team had a couple of highlight plays from DeAndre Hopkins and Odell Beckham Jr., but those represented the only bright spots in the shellacking.Meanwhile, Logan Paul – one of the two, non-football players on Wildcats FFC's roster – was a lowlight during the game. He was penalized early for ripping Doucette's glasses off and later appeared to take a snap off to open a collector pack, which resulted in a touchdown for Team USA.Next up, Tom Brady and the Founders FFC will look to earn a win in their first game of the tournament.4:50 pm ET March 21, 2026Odell Beckham Jr. makes ridiculous one-handed catch on 2-point conversionJacob CamenkerTeam USA and the Wildcats traded touchdowns to open the 15-minute second half, with Odell Beckham Jr. getting into the end-zone on fourth-and-goal. Beckham's touchdown catch was easy, but his 2-point conversion was a thing of beauty, as he outjumped two Team USA defenders to make a one-handed catch.The ball used in flag football is smaller than the one used in the NFL, but Beckham Jr.'s catch was nonetheless impressive. It also brought back fond memories of the iconic, one-handed catch he had on "Sunday Night Football" against the Dallas Cowboys during his rookie season in 2014.4:44 pm ET March 21, 2026Team USA leading Wildcats 19-6 at halftimeJacob CamenkerTeam USA enjoyed a dominant first half to open the round robin tournament. The Wildcats had a lot of trouble containing the national team's speedy playmakers, and struggled immensely to grab their flags without being penalized for making significant contact or holding.Darrell "Housh" Doucette III has proven difficult to contain and is lending credence to his 2024 comments that Team USA's knowledge of the flag game would give it a big-time advantage over NFL players trying to play the game.4:41 pm ET March 21, 2026Joe Burrow, DeAndre Hopkins connection gets Wildcats FFC on boardJacob CamenkerIt took three possessions, but Wildcats FFC finally managed to get on the board. Burrow took a lateral from Saquon Barkley before launching the ball down the field to Hopkins, who made a contested, one-handed catch in the end-zone.The Wildcats weren't able to convert the point after and were trailing 12-6 after the score.4:17 pm ET March 21, 2026Team USA opens scoring vs. WildcatsJacob CamenkerTeam USA is off to a good start in its quest to show it can hang with NFL talent on the flag football field. They stopped Joe Burrow's Wildcats on the first drive of the game before methodically marching down the field before seeing Darrell Doucette run in a score to open the game.Doucette started jawing with Logan Paul just after he got into the end zone, and Paul ripped the glasses off the face of his opponent, resulting in a penalty. Team USA couldn't convert its 2-point opportunity, but they have an early 6-0 lead.4:09 pm ET March 21, 2026Logan Paul participating in Fanatics Flag Football ClassicJacob CamenkerThe Fanatics Flag Football Classic will largely feature NFL and flag football players, but there are a few notable exceptions.One is Logan Paul, a professional wrestler and boxer who will be competing as part of Wildcats FFC during the event.Paul has made headlines for beefing with Tom Brady and Rob Gronkowski in advance of the event. He was also spotted at practice for the event getting juked by Saquon Barkley and intercepting Joe Burrow.Paul played high school football at Westlake High School in Ohio. He earned a special mention as part of the AP's All-Ohio second team voting following his senior season in 2012.4:07 pm ET March 21, 2026Team USA to face Wildcats FFC in opening gameJacob CamenkerThose hoping to see Tom Brady in the Fanatics Flag Football Classic will have to wait a little bit longer. Joe Burrow and Jayden Daniels' Wildcats FFC will open the round robin tournament by facing off against Team USA in a 30-minute game.Team USA will be led by quarterback Darrell "Housh" Doucette III, who has been vocal that flag football players "deserve their opportunity" to compete at the 2028 Olympics.4:00 pm ET March 21, 2026Flag football Olympic rules, explainedJacob CamenkerThe Fanatics Flag Football Classic will largely use the same format that is to be used at the 2028 Olympics.The "Standard Style" of international flag football play is five-on-five, according to the International Federation of American Football (IFAF). Rather than tackling offensive players to complete a play, defenders pull a standardized flag – roughly 15 inches long by two inches wide – off of a belt worn by each player.The game takes place on a field that is 50 yards long and 25 yards wide, and no players may line up as offensive or defensive linemen. Rosters will have a 12-player maximum and all teams only have players of the same gender.Usually, flag football games are 40 minutes long, split into 20-minute halves with a two-minute halftime break. Fanatics' flag football event on March 21 will be a 30-minute game with two 15-minute halves and a running clock.Each team gets four downs to attempt to cross midfield for a new set of downs. An unsuccessful set of downs gives the ball back to the defense on its own 5-yard line. An interception gives the defense the ball at the spot where the play ends.Teams are allowed to run the ball anywhere on the field besides the five-yard areas directly bordering the end zone. Jumping and diving as the ball-carrier in any context is illegal.Each team's defense can have a maximum of two blitzers that may rush the quarterback directly so long as all parts of their bodies are more than seven yards from the line of scrimmage before the snap.3:47 pm ET March 21, 2026Team USA flag football rosterJacob CamenkerThere are currently 12 players on the U.S. men's flag football team, according to the team's official website. All are set to participate in the Fanatics Flag Football Classic.Below is a full look at the team's current roster:Aamir BrownVelton Brown Jr.Isaiah CalhounNico CasaresMike DanielsLaval DavisTyler DavisDarrell "Housh" Doucette IIIJa'Deion HighJamie KennedyLaderrick "Pablo" SmithShawn Theard Jr.Team USA also has six alternates listed on its official roster page. They are as follows:Michael BetterNoah BickleyAntonio ColemanJohnluis HernandezLennox HowardSean Moore3:35 pm ET March 21, 2026Flag football positionsJacob CamenkerIn 5-on-5 flag football – the format being used both at the Fanatics Flag Football Classic and the 2028 Olympics – there are seven total positions a player can play, according to the NFL's dedicated flag football website.Most align with the traditional positions seen in the NFL, but some – notably the center spot on offense – operate in a different capacity.Here's what to know about the flag football positions:OffenseQuarterback: Receives the snap and passes the ball or hands it off. They cannot run with the ball after the snap.Center: Snaps the ball to the quarterback before becoming an eligible receiver.Wide receiver: Runs routes in an effort to catch a pass. Teams typically use two or three receivers in 5-on-5 flag football.Running back: Can run the ball after taking a handoff or receive a pass. Can also throw the ball after accepting a hand-off.DefenseDefensive back: Typically tasked with covering wide receivers.Safety: Stands further behind the line of scrimmage and is responsible for corralling opposing players who get loose.Rusher: Tries to chase down the quarterback and prevent them from passing the ball. Must be at least seven feet off the line of scrimmage at the snap to rush the passer.3:32 pm ET March 21, 2026Fanatics Flag Football Classic rostersJacob CamenkerBelow is a full look at the rosters of the three teams set to play in the Fanatics Flag Football Classic.Founders FFC rosterTom BradyTerence CrawfordStefon DiggsRob GronkowskiDamar HamlinJalen HurtsAshton JeantyAlvin KamaraVon MillerPatrick PetersonDeVonta SmithAntoine Winfield Jr.Wildcats FFC rosterDavante AdamsSaquon BarkleyOdell Beckham Jr.Joe BurrowJayden DanielsDeAndre HopkinsIShowSpeedDerwin James Jr.Kyle JuszczykLuke KuechlyLogan PaulJalen RamseyU.S. men's national team rosterAamir BrownVelton Brown Jr.Isaiah CalhounNico CasaresMike DanielsLaval DavisTyler DavisDarrell "Housh" Doucette IIIJa'Deion HighJamie KennedyLaderrick "Pablo" SmithShawn Theard Jr.3:22 pm ET March 21, 2026Is Tom Brady playing flag football today?Jacob CamenkerYes, Brady is slated to compete in the Fanatics Flag Football Classic. The 48-year-old is a co-captain of the Founders FFC roster, along with quarterback Jalen Hurts, and will look to help lead his squad to victory in the round robin tournament.While Brady expressed excitement about participating in the event, he said it was "unlikely" he would use it as a launching point for a bid to make the 2028 Olympic team."If I ever wanted to come in as an advisory role or as a coach, something like that, that's probably better suited for me," Brady said of participating in the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. "But I'll let the young Patrick Mahomes and Josh Allen get out there and try to win a gold medal for the U.S."3:13 pm ET March 21, 2026Where is the Fanatics Flag Football Classic?Jacob CamenkerVenue: BMO StadiumLocation: Los Angeles, CaliforniaThe Fanatics Flag Football Classic will be played at BMO Stadium, which is the venue set to host flag football events during the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.Originally, the Fanatics Flag Football Classic was scheduled to be held at Kingdom Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. However, the event's organizers opted to move the showcase amid the Iran war and travel advisories in the Middle East.2:53 pm ET March 21, 2026Where to watch Fanatics Flag Football Classic: TV channel, streamingJacob CamenkerTV channel: FoxLive stream: Fox One | Tubi | FuboFox is set to broadcast the inaugural Fanatics Flag Football Classic on Saturday, March 21. The network will also make it available through its proprietary streaming service, Fox One, and Tubi – a Fox-owned, ad-supported free streaming platform.Cord-cutters can also catch the flag football showcase on Fubo, which comes with a free trial.Watch the Fanatics Flag Football Classic with Fubo2:53 pm ET March 21, 2026What time is the Fanatics Flag Football Classic?Jacob CamenkerTime: 4 p.m. ET (1 p.m. PT)The Fanatics Flag Football Classic will begin at 4 p.m. ET on March 21. The event will feature a Round Robin tournament among the three participating teams: Founder FFC, Wildcats FCC, and Team USA Football.
